name: kasauti
description: Industry-standard code quality metrics (cyclomatic, cognitive, Halstead, maintainability, duplication) with an A–E grade and a live 3D pyramid of your codebase. Offline. 24 languages fully, every other language partially.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: KASAUTI only reads and parses files; it never runs your code.

viewsWelcome.contents:
No findings yet.
[Scan workspace](command:kasauti.scanWorkspace)
Findings for open files appear here as you type.

commands.title: Show This File in the Pyramid

kasauti.liveAnalysis.description: Re-analyze the file while you type (like Live Preview), without waiting for save.

kasauti.liveDelayMs.description: Pause after the last keystroke before re-analyzing, in milliseconds.

kasauti.thresholds.cyclomatic.description: CQ001: maximum cyclomatic complexity per function (McCabe's recommendation: 10).

kasauti.thresholds.cognitive.description: CQ002: maximum cognitive complexity per function (SonarSource default: 15).

kasauti.thresholds.functionLength.description: CQ003: maximum lines of code per function.

kasauti.thresholds.parameters.description: CQ004: maximum parameters per function (SonarSource default: 7).

kasauti.thresholds.nesting.description: CQ005: maximum nesting depth of control flow (SonarSource default: 3).

kasauti.thresholds.fileLength.description: CQ006: maximum lines per file (SonarSource default: 1000).

kasauti.thresholds.duplicationTokens.description: CQ007: minimum size of a duplicated block, in tokens.

kasauti.thresholds.maintainabilityWarnin.description: CQ008: maintainability index below this is a warning (Visual Studio band).

kasauti.thresholds.maintainabilityCritic.description: CQ008: maintainability index below this is critical (Visual Studio band).

kasauti.thresholds.classMethods.description: CQ009: maximum methods per class (SonarSource default: 35).

kasauti.includePartialAnalysisInScore.description: Count files with partial analysis (languages without a parser) in folder and workspace scores.

enumDescriptions: Show findings in the Problems panel for open files only.
Show findings for every scanned file.
Do not show findings in the Problems panel.
kasauti.diagnostics.scope.description: Which files get squiggles and Problems-panel entries.

kasauti.codeLens.enabled.description: Show grade and complexity above each function.

kasauti.exclude.description: Extra glob patterns to exclude from scans, e.g. "**/generated/**". .gitignore and dependency folders are already excluded.

kasauti.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this are skipped.

kasauti.additionalPartialAnalysisExtensi.description: Extra file extensions (e.g. ".abc") to analyze with partial, language-independent analysis.

kasauti.colorBlindPalette.description: Use a color-blind-safe palette (Okabe–Ito) for grades.

kasauti.largeWorkspaceWarning.description: Ask before scanning workspaces with more files than this.

enumDescriptions: Only the grade — the least noisy.
Only the numbers: complexity, cognitive complexity, lines.
kasauti.codeLens.mode.description: How much each CodeLens shows above a function.

kasauti.codeLens.maxSymbols.description: Above this many functions in one file, CodeLens is suppressed. Generated files can contain thousands of functions, and a lens on each one makes the file unreadable.

scripts.package: npm run typecheck && npm run build:prod && vsce package --no-dependencies
